description: Replace a Mailchimp template's HTML (Mailchimp's update replaces the whole template, so pass the full html), optionally with a new name. The unsubscribe footer is added if the html has none. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: update_mailchimp_template
title: Update a Mailchimp template
